caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition with a dominant background color of reddish-brown. In the upper section, there are three human figures: on the left, a person wearing a red top and yellow pants is riding a black horse facing right, with blue flowers visible near the horse’s head; in the center, a figure wearing a blue skirt and white blouse is standing with one hand on her hip, surrounded by green and pink foliage; to the right, another person is dressed in a yellow outfit with red trim, appearing to dance or pose, with blue flowers and a large pink and white flower nearby. The lower section features a decorative band with stylized, round, multi-petal flowers in blue, white, and purple tones, along with green and pink leaves extending horizontally across the strip. A thin, gray border runs along the top and bottom of the reddish-brown field, each decorated with a repeating pattern of white and black dots. The bottom part of the drawing is left blank with a cream-colored background.
title: Plate 42: Painted Chest Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
